message:
The emulation check didn't find a fault in our design: it reports no test failures, and the whole flow is still connected from consent through redaction to agent approval, with no automatic CRM write. It's blocked only because the export tool has no generator yet for these eight Google Cloud components (Cloud Run consent and streaming services, Speech-to-Text, Sensitive Data Protection, Vertex AI Search, the orchestrator, Gemini) or a plan to reference the existing call source. Changing the diagram can't fix that, and swapping in a supported storage-only contract would cut the scope you asked for, so I've left the board as it is. Building those generators is product engineering work, and this report plus artifact e119feab… is the reproducer.

Meanwhile, let's settle a decision that will matter whichever services we end up building: should the assistant read customer context from the existing CRM during the call (and if so, which CRM is it), or should it only prepare the draft update for the agent to apply by hand?
